items.description: Maputsoe is a major industrial town in the Leribe district, located on the border with South Africa.
Morija is an important cultural and educational center, home to the country's first mission station.
Semonkong is famous for the Maletsunyane Falls, one of the highest single-drop waterfalls in Africa.
Peka is a town in the Leribe district, serving as a regional center for agriculture and commerce.
Tsakholo is a rural settlement in the Mafeteng district, primarily focused on farming and local trade.
Sekake is a village in the Qacha's Nek district, located in the rugged highlands of south-eastern Lesotho.
Ha Lejone is a scenic village overlooking the Katse Dam reservoir, popular for its stunning mountain views.
Katse is the site of the massive Katse Dam, a central piece of the Lesotho Highlands Water Project.
Saint Michaels is a mountain village in the Maseru district, providing a starting point for various treks.
Khabos is a settlement in the Leribe district, known for its community of high-altitude farmers.
Maphutseng is a historic village known for its paleontological sites and fossilized dinosaur footprints.
Alwynskop is a village in the Quthing district, named after the abundance of aloe plants in the area.
Letseng-la-Terae is home to the world's highest diamond mine, operating at an altitude of over 3,100 meters.
